messages:
alicia_cs: Heads-up: Aurora wants to add 15 seats midterm and move billing for the added seats to their EU subsidiary (Aurora Europe SARL). They also asked for a one-time activation credit of €4,000 applied to the EU invoice and prefer invoices in EUR for EU. They uploaded a PO that uses the parent name. Can Billing + Legal advise next steps?
ben_sales: We can allocate seats. Need effective date to prorate and confirm seat rate. Also manager sign-off on activation credit; I'll check.
mira_fin: EU invoices in EUR OK if they provide IBAN + VAT ID. If their PO references parent name we'll ask for corrected PO or a signed mapping table showing which PO maps to which legal entity. Activation credit applied on first EU invoice is fine but finance needs the credit wording in the amendment. Payment terms default to net30 unless they request otherwise.
tom_legal: E-sign is standard. If they insist on wet-sign for EU, we'll accept scanned signed page with attestation. Draft amendment should include: (1) billing allocation table, (2) currency and VAT fields, (3) credit clause with non-transferable language, (4) signature attestation.
alicia_cs: Effective add date = 2024-05-15, seats = 15, seat rate = $1,150/seat/yr but billing in EUR at invoice FX. They want the activation credit only for EU seats.
mira_fin: Ok math: annual = 15 * 1150 = $17,250 -> prorated for remainder. We'll convert to EUR on invoice date. Need VAT ID and PO corrected by 2024-05-10 to hit May billing.
ben_sales: Manager approved €4,000 activation credit if amendment signed by 2024-05-12. I'll add that condition. Also customer asks that the parent keep historical invoices; only new seats billed to EU.
tom_legal: I'll draft amendment and a one-page PO mapping table that they can attach. Attestation clause: "Signer attests authority to bind Aurora Europe SARL." If they request wet-sign courier we'll push back and accept scanned page first.
esign_bot: DocuSign envelope aurora-eu-amend-2024 queued. Set to standard e-sign; will switch to manual upload for scanned wet-sign if Legal requests.
alicia_cs: I'll ask procurement to upload corrected PO + VAT and confirm authorized signatory email. Target: draft to customer by 2024-05-02, signoff by 2024-05-12. I'll update thread when they respond. :thumbsup:
